title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): simplified agent creation experience
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's overdue target and separates the planned change from documented Agent Builder background. The blocking path, beta API and general licensing statements are supported. The natural-language pilot advice should retain Microsoft's language-availability qualification.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block reaches the per-agent blocking control.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents. In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.

claims.claim: POST /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
claims.quote: Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage. POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.claim: The Package Management blocking API is a beta API.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.
claims.quote: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license.

claims.claim: Block and unblock act on an existing agent's availability, rather than controlling creation.
claims.quote: These actions apply to the selected agent. Block and unblock: Restrict access to an agent across the organization, preventing any user from using it.

claims.claim: Administrators cannot disable Agent Builder creation separately while keeping agents enabled.
claims.quote: Administrators can't disable agent creation in Agent Builder separately while keeping agents enabled.

claims.claim: Creating agents in Agent Builder is a core Copilot capability when agents are enabled.
